intentEvidence: Color text in Obsidian with markup that carries the color itself.
problem: Text color styling often renders differently across Live Preview, Reading Mode, and PDF exports, leading to visual inconsistencies.

relations.evidence: A lean fork of Fast Text Color by Leon Holtmeier.
relations.plugin: Fast Text Color by Leon Holtmeier

summary: A color markup plugin that uses hex codes to color text, ensuring consistent rendering across live preview, reading mode, and PDF export.
